chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from Al-Washshāʾ, from ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, who said:
I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
“And of those whom We have created is a community who guide by the truth and thereby act justly.”
He عليه السلام said: “They are the Imams.”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh, Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.أُمَّةٌ: a community or group distinguished by guidance
key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةُ: the Imams, the divinely appointed leaders
key_terms.بِالْحَقِّ: by means of the truth, with true guidance
key_terms.قَوْلِ اللَّهِ: the statement of Allah in the Qur'an
key_terms.يَعْدِلُونَ: they act justly or judge with justice

ai.seo_question: Who are the people described in the Qur'an as guiding by the truth and judging with it?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic description of a community that guides by the truth and acts with justice as referring to the Imams عليهم السلام. It presents the Imams as the divinely guided leaders who embody true guidance and just authority.
